name: FormatPropertyText (property text to display form: the property service parses it, integers and floats go through the language service, text is copied)
notes: Lane AJ. Hooked (not yet run in-game). Query of the framework service (ids 0xac1887e / 0x4bb0d269) for the property service; the text goes to its slot 8 as a service-allocated std::string (built and tidied through AssignServiceString / TidyString) and the answer's type id (slot 4) picks the formatter: 0xc264712 / 0xeb61e4f7 language slot 18 with the number as 64 bits (sign-extended / zero-extended), 0xabc78708 slot 19 with the float widened to double and a "%f" cRZString, 0xb8bea18 a text object's ToChar into the output's FromChar (nothing when null), anything else 0. Returns the formatter's byte as is. ORIGINAL-BUG: a missing property service is dereferenced (not tested). Differential test, 20,000 seeds on recording fakes of the framework, property service, values, language service, output string and allocator service (sizes, frees, leaks); text lengths around the 15/16 boundary, null answers, errors injected into the parse, both formatters and ToChar (the string is freed, the reference released). Mutants killed (10): high word of both integers, format text, text result, string tidy, service release, null answer, query ids, case label, float argument order.
